assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI asset for a Korean cozy animal companion mobile game. One single horizontal open storybook menu panel, front view, landscape 3:2. Ivory handmade paper with subtle watercolor fibers, soft buttery cream interior covering 90 percent, gently uneven scalloped rounded edges, thin layered paper border and a faint warm soft shadow. Tiny hand-painted sage leaves, acorns and white daisies only at the extreme four corners, no characters. Whimsical storybook watercolor matching cute cream woodland animals with muted brown linework. VERY faint tiny paw and leaf watermark accents around edges only, center completely blank and nearly uniform pale ivory for legible dark text. This is a reusable 9-slice UI panel: straight repeatable central borders, all decoration confined to outer 12 percent, balanced symmetry. Actual transparent background outside the paper silhouette. No text, no letters, no UI icons, no mockup, no extra objects, no screenshot, one isolated asset.

Use case: stylized-concept. A single wide horizontal title plaque for a cozy woodland pet mobile game, 4:1 wide composition. Hand-painted watercolor sage green fabric ribbon laid over cream paper with softly scalloped lobes and little rounded curled ends, subtle textile texture and brown pencil outline, pale warm yellow highlights, delicate stitched rim. Very small cluster of an acorn, sage leaves and two cream daisies tucked at each far end. Large uninterrupted muted light sage center occupying 78 percent of width for dark readable Korean text placed later. Charming crafted storybook object with tactile layers, muted natural colors, no flat neon. Reusable 9-slice UI art: keep corner decoration only in outer 10 percent and long central edge straight. Front view, no perspective, isolated, true transparent background, no text or letters, no buttons, no scene, no border beyond the object. High-quality production game UI art, not a mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. A seamless square paper texture tile for item cards in a cozy woodland animal companion game. Warm pale ivory handmade paper with very subtle watercolor and cotton fibers. Scatter tiny whimsical pale sage leaf pairs, faded acorns, faint cream pawprints and little four petal daisy marks in a balanced repeating pattern with generous blank spacing. Motifs must be extremely subtle, low contrast about 8 percent, no saturated colors. Soft children storybook watercolor style, muted sepia pencil details. Edge-to-edge opaque square texture suitable for repeating across a UI card; no frame, no shadow, no text, no scene, no objects, no UI screenshot. It must remain easy to read dark brown text over it, center same density as edges. High-quality raster game UI material.
